title: ddPCR Titration of Lentivirus Vectors
author: Addgene The Nonprofit Plasmid Repository
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be7ijhke
materials: Gently aspirate media from the 6-well plates.
Before handling any viruses get materials ready.
After the plate has been sealed, proceed to thermocycling.
Open the QuantaSoft software to set up a new plate layout. Designate the sample name, experiment type, supermix type (ddPCR Supermix for Probes), the target names and target types.

steps.title: Prepare virus dilution series
steps.instruction: Create a serial dilution of lentivirus in DMEM complete. When adding virus to diluent, pipette the virus five times to clear the tip. Mix each dilution by setting a P200 to 200 µL and pipetting 10–20 times. Use a fresh tip for each transfer and repeat for all dilutions.

steps.title: Dispense viral dilutions to plate
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of each viral dilution to a separate well of a 6‑well plate (one dilution per well) and leave one well untransduced as a control.

steps.title: Seed cells with Polybrene
steps.instruction: Seed 300 000 cells per well in 1350 µL complete media containing 11.1 µg/mL Polybrene into the virus‑containing wells and the untransduced control. For even seeding, prepare a bulk suspension of 3 000 000 cells in 13.5 mL media with 11.1 µg/mL Polybrene for up to 10 wells, mix well, and dispense 150 µL virus (which is diluted an additional 10‑fold, giving final dilutions of 25‑ to 1600‑fold). Mix each well with a 1 mL pipette 5–10 times; final well volume is 1.5 mL and final Polybrene concentration is 10 µg/mL.

steps.title: Incubate transduced cells 72 h
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 72 hours.

steps.title: Add Benzonase to wells
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL of 50 U/mL Benzonase in DMEM complete to each well.

steps.title: Incubate with Benzonase 30 min at 37°C
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash wells with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash each well with 1 mL 1X PBS and aspirate the wash.

steps.title: Detach cells with TrypLE
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL TrypLE to each well and incubate 1–2 minutes to detach cells.

steps.title: Resuspend cells and transfer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the detached cells in 500 µL complete DMEM and transfer the suspension to a microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 5 minutes at 100 × g (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Wash cell pellet with PBS
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, wash the cell pellet with 500 µL PBS.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again for 5 minutes at 100 × g (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from the pellet using the GeneJet Genomic DNA Purification Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of each DNA sample on a spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Prepare 25 ng/µL DNA stocks
steps.instruction: Dilute each sample to a final concentration of 25 ng/µL. Use immediately for ddPCR or store at –20 °C until needed.

steps.title: Thaw reagents on ice
steps.instruction: Thaw DNA samples, primers/probe mixes, and ddPCR master mix on ice.

steps.title: Vortex and spin reagents
steps.instruction: Vortex primers/probe mixes and master mix for 15 seconds, spin 10 seconds in a mini‑centrifuge, then keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare DG8 cartridge holder
steps.instruction: Wipe the DG8 cartridge holder with bleach and place it inside the biological safety cabinet (BSC).

steps.title: Verify BSC tip supply
steps.instruction: Confirm that the BSC is stocked with sufficient pipette tips.

steps.title: Pre‑warm plate sealer
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm the 96‑well plate sealer by gently touching its screen.

steps.title: Cool ddPCR plate on freezer block
steps.instruction: Place a ddPCR plate onto a chilled 96‑well freezer block and keep it in the BSC to cool.

steps.title: Prepare RRE/RPP30 master mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the RRE/RPP30 ddPCR master mix in a microcentrifuge tube as described; for 8 samples make enough mix for 9 reactions.

steps.title: Vortex and spin master mix
steps.instruction: Vortex the master mix for 15 seconds, spin 10 seconds in a mini‑centrifuge, then keep on ice.

steps.title: Place PCR tube strip in freezer block
steps.instruction: Place an 8‑well PCR tube strip into the chilled 96‑well freezer block.

steps.title: Add master mix to PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Add 16 µL of the master mix to each PCR tube, dispensing to the bottom without allowing drops to cling to the tube walls.

steps.title: Add DNA samples to PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL of the 25 ng/µL DNA sample to the corresponding PCR tubes and pipette the mixture back and forth five times.

steps.title: Insert DG8 cartridge
steps.instruction: Place a DG8 cartridge into the cartridge holder.

steps.title: Load reaction mix into cartridge
steps.instruction: Using a 2–50 µL multichannel pipette, load 20 µL of each reaction mixture into the middle wells of the cartridge.

steps.title: Add droplet generation oil to reservoir
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL of droplet generation oil to a polystyrene reagent reservoir.

steps.title: Load oil into cartridge bottom wells
steps.instruction: Using a 20–200 µL multichannel pipette, load 70 µL of droplet generation oil into the bottom row wells of the cartridge.

steps.title: Seal cartridge with gasket
steps.instruction: Cover the cartridge with the DG8 gasket, ensuring it is securely seated.

steps.title: Generate droplets in droplet generator
steps.instruction: Transfer the cartridge holder to the droplet generator, close the lid, and wait for droplet generation to complete.

steps.title: Aspirate droplets from cartridge
steps.instruction: Using a 20–200 µL multichannel pipette, aspirate 40 µL of droplets. Insert tips into the centre of the well, tilt to 45°, and slowly aspirate while counting to 20.

steps.title: Transfer droplets to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Dispense the droplets into a pre‑chilled PCR plate: insert tips, touch the bottom, lift ~1 mm, touch the side, tilt to 45°, and gently dispense while counting to 20.

steps.title: Seal PCR plate with foil
steps.instruction: Place a Pierceable Foil Heat Seal on the PCR plate (red line up). If the sealer is not at temperature, touch its screen to heat. Once at temperature, place the plate on the metal support block, insert the block into the sealer, and press the ‘Seal’ button.

steps.title: Run ddPCR thermal program
steps.instruction: Run the ddPCR plate using the specified PCR parameters (as provided in the protocol).

steps.title: Transfer plate to droplet reader
steps.instruction: After PCR, move the sealed plate to the Droplet Reader.

steps.title: Start droplet reading
steps.instruction: In the Droplet Reader software, select ‘Run’ to begin reading the droplets.

steps.title: Export reading data as CSV
steps.instruction: When reading is complete, export data from all wells as a CSV file for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Calculate viral titers
steps.instruction: Calculate viruses per genome: Viruses/genome = 2 × (Copies/20 µL RRE) / (Copies/20 µL RPP30). Then compute infectious titer: Infectious titer = (viruses/genome) × (#cells/well) × (dilution factor) / (virus volume). Finally, average the infectious titers from the appropriate dilutions to obtain the final titer.
